questions_and_answers.question: Harris invited us to visit the Air Mission.

answers.text: Harris nos invitó a visitar la Misión de la Fuerza Aérea.

questions_and_answers.question: He said we could come this Saturday or next.

answers.text: Dijo que podríamos venir este sábado o el próximo.

questions_and_answers.question: I’m not going to be able to go this Saturday.

answers.text: No voy a poder ir este sábado.

questions_and_answers.question: We can leave it for the next one, then.

answers.text: Podemos dejarlo para el próximo, entonces.

questions_and_answers.question: Please carry the suitcases for us.

answers.text: Tenga la bondad de llevarnos las maletas.

questions_and_answers.question: Let’s go shopping with Mrs. Harris.

answers.text: Vamos de compras con la señora Harris.

articles.text: This lesson practises inviting someone and making polite requests. Pay attention to the verb forms and courtesy markers.

metadata.instructions: Translate the following invitations and polite requests into Spanish.
